children: Hepion Pharmaceuticals entered into a financing with Gravitas Capital, issuing a $500,000 secured convertible note and a warrant for 12,500,000 shares. The note carries 8% PIK interest and matures on Sep 3, 2027, with conversion at $0.04 per share after stockholders approve an increase in authorized shares. The warrant is exercisable at $0.06 per share from Sep 3, 2026 through Sep 3, 2031, contingent on the same approval. The note is secured by all company assets under a security agreement.
: Secured convertible note financing with warrant and security agreement
